welcome: Smoother quest-focus following and more accurate nameplate previews.

sections.title: Keep following through quest pickups
items: Fixed another timing case where accepting a quest could ask you to stop following a party member’s quest focus. Automatic changes keep following active; deliberately choosing a different quest still asks.

sections.title: Nameplates that match your settings
items: In friendly-player name-only mode, every QT icon position now follows the name text. Left and Prefix share the same position.
Forever previews now center names above the health bar and show the level badge on its right. The player preview follows name-only mode and explains where to change that Blizzard setting.
Retail previews now reflect native nameplate styles, sizes, fonts and health-display settings.
